items.exampleEn: This watch comes with a lifetime guarantee.
items.exampleZh: 這支手錶享有終身保固。

items.exampleEn: Snow seldom falls in this part of the country.
The shop is temporarily closed for repairs.
items.exampleZh: 這家店因整修暫時關閉。

items.exampleEn: A short video will precede the main talk.
items.exampleZh: 主要演講之前會先播一段短片。

items.exampleEn: Seasonal fruit is usually cheaper and fresher.
items.exampleZh: 當季水果通常比較便宜，也比較新鮮。

items.exampleEn: Please write the serial number of your laptop on the form.
items.exampleZh: 請把你筆電的序號寫在表格上。

items.exampleEn: The museum is only open in the daytime.
The hourly news on the radio is only five minutes long.
items.exampleZh: 電台每小時整點播報的新聞只有五分鐘長。

items.sentenceEn: During the daytime, the trains run every ten minutes.
items.sentenceZh: 白天時，火車每十分鐘一班。

items.audioEn: The elevator is temporarily out of service. Please use the stairs on your left.
items.audioZh: 電梯暫時停止服務。請使用您左手邊的樓梯。

items.sentenceEn: My grandmother seldom watches TV; she prefers to read.
items.sentenceZh: 我奶奶很少看電視，她比較喜歡看書。

items.sentenceEn: Mangoes are seasonal, so they are expensive in winter.
items.sentenceZh: 芒果是季節性水果，所以冬天很貴。

items.stemEn: In this job, the ____ pay is low, so I have to work long days to earn enough.
items.stemZh: 這份工作的時薪很低，所以我得每天工作很久才賺得夠。

items.stemEn: At this company, a training course must ____ your first day of work.
items.stemZh: 在這家公司，正式上班第一天之前必須先上訓練課程。

items.passageEn: Every summer, a hotel by the sea hires seasonal workers. Last year, my cousin Ryan took one of these jobs. He was paid an hourly rate, and he worked mostly in the daytime, cleaning rooms and helping guests. A short training course preceded his first day. In it, he learned to check the serial number on every key card so that guests would not get the wrong room. Ryan seldom had free time, but he enjoyed the work. When the hotel was temporarily short of staff in August, he worked nights too. He says it was a once-in-a-lifetime experience.
items.passageZh: 每年夏天，一家海邊的飯店都會僱用季節性員工。去年，我的表親 Ryan 接了其中一份工作。他領時薪，大多在白天上班，負責打掃房間、協助客人。上班第一天之前，他先上了一堂簡短的訓練課程，學會檢查每張房卡上的序號，讓客人不會拿錯房間。Ryan 很少有空閒時間，但他很喜歡這份工作。八月時飯店暫時人手不足，他連晚上也上班。他說那是一生難得一次的經驗。

questions.questionZh: Ryan 上班第一天之前做了什麼？
options: 參加了簡短的訓練課程

questions.questionZh: 八月時 Ryan 為什麼連晚上也上班？
options: 有客人特別要求他晚上服務

items.promptZh: 我很少在晚上十點以後喝咖啡。
referenceEn: I seldom drink coffee after ten at night.
I seldom have coffee after ten in the evening.
rubricZh: seldom 通常放在一般動詞前面（例如 I seldom drink…）
「喝咖啡」可寫 drink coffee、have coffee 等；「晚上十點以後」可寫 after ten at night、after 10 p.m. 等

items.promptZh: 我妹妹暫時住在我家，直到她找到新的公寓。
referenceEn: My sister is temporarily staying with me until she finds a new apartment.
My younger sister is living at my place temporarily until she finds a new apartment.
rubricZh: temporarily 可放動詞前或句尾（例如 is temporarily staying、is living here temporarily 等）
「住在我家」可寫，例如 stay with me、live at my place 等；時態可用現在進行式或現在式
until 後面用現在式表示未來（例如 until she finds 等）
